question.text: A ball is projected vertically upward with an initial velocity of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>50</mn><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></math>. At <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></math>, another ball is projected vertically upward with same velocity. At <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>t</mi><mo>=</mo></math>____<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></math>, second ball will meet the first ball <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn><msup><mrow><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></math>.

solution.text:
Distance covered by ball A is h=502-12×10×22=100-20=80 m

Now, at time t=2 s, velocity of A is vA=50-10×2=30 m s-1

Relative velocity of both balls after 2 s is vrel=50-30=20 m s-1

Here, relative displacement xrel=80 m s-1 and relative accelerationarel=0.

Time taken t=8020=4 s

Time at which they will meet is t=4+2=6 s
